facts.fact: The Company's council ended by agreeing that nobody answers the queen until she has spoken in the open at the gate; no vote on her offer was taken.
facts.why: needed because ch 20 promised a vote that night and ch 21's bargain depends on hearing her at the gate first

facts.fact: Devan took the oilcloth bundle (chit, payment writ, cut gift seal) from his pack and returned it to the shutter-frame hollow behind the third slat for the night.
facts.why: needed because ch 21's beat has the bundle in the hollow at dawn, while F744 had it in his pack on the hill

facts.fact: The grey river pebble Devan left on the warden's chamber sill in book 1 is still there, undisturbed.
Devan tells Neela he will tell the queen to her face first, then read the payment writ aloud at the gate in daylight before the Company and the garrison.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him say he will read the writ before the queen
